jobs.title: Senior / Staff Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About Passionfroot

Creator-led growth is one of the fastest-growing channels in B2B—and we’re building the infrastructure behind it.

Passionfroot is the leading platform where modern companies scale creator-led growth, and where top creators manage and monetize brand partnerships.

Our customers include some of the most ambitious, fastest-moving companies in the world—Replit, HubSpot, Figma, Cursor, Gamma, Attio, Intercom, and ElevenLabs. We help them run high-impact creator programs across LinkedIn, YouTube, newsletters, and more.

We're growing 13x in revenue year over year, profitable, and just closed our Series A round! We are backed by leading investors including Insight Partners, Creandum, Supernode and founders and operators from Cursor, Anthropic, n8n and more. We're expanding fast across New York, Europe, and Brazil - and we're just getting started.

We’re still a small team, which means the people who join now will have an outsized influence on the product, the engineering culture, and the company we become.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Product Engineer to help build the next generation of Passionfroot.

You’ll work across the full stack on both our core platform and Zest, our AI Campaign Manager for creator marketing. That could mean designing a new workflow for managing creator campaigns, making collaboration data feel instant, or turning models, search, and product context into a reliable AI experience that customers can trust.

We don’t separate “AI engineering” from “product engineering.” AI is becoming part of how the product works, but great product fundamentals still matter: understanding the user, shaping the problem, choosing the right architecture, building a thoughtful experience, and operating it reliably in production.

You’ll work closely with the founders, design, and customers to take important problems from early exploration to shipped product.

We’re a team of six engineers, and staying small is deliberate. It means you can have an idea on Monday and have customers using it by Thursday—without layers of sprint ceremonies or alignment meetings in between. The flip side is real ownership: you need to exercise strong judgment, communicate your decisions, and think through their consequences rather than wait for someone else to catch them.

What you’ll do

  • Own meaningful product areas from problem definition through architecture, implementation, launch, and iteration.

  • Build customer-facing features across our marketplace, campaign management, collaboration, payments, analytics, and creator workflows.

  • Help make Zest an indispensable part of how modern companies run creator-led growth.

  • Turn foundation models into structured, reliable product experiences—not just impressive prototypes.

  • Work on intelligent workflows involving agents, tools, retrieval, search, recommendations, and generated interfaces.

  • Develop the evaluations, observability, and feedback loops needed to understand whether AI features are genuinely useful.

  • Work closely with design to create experiences that are fast, intuitive, and polished.

  • Talk directly with customers and translate ambiguous needs into simple product decisions.

  • Make pragmatic architectural choices that balance speed, quality, maintainability, and performance.

  • Improve the systems and engineering practices that help a small team ship reliably at high velocity.

  • At Staff level, provide technical direction across projects, raise the engineering bar, and help other engineers make better decisions.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience building and shipping high-quality, customer-facing software. 5+ years is a useful guide, but the scope and quality of your work matter more than the number.

  • Strong TypeScript and React fundamentals, with experience working across the full stack.

  • A track record of independently driving complex features or products from an ambiguous starting point to measurable customer impact. When you encounter a blocker, you investigate, communicate, and find another path forward without waiting to be managed.

  • Strong product and technical judgment. You care about what should be built, how it should feel, and whether it actually solves the problem. You can distinguish between problems that need a sophisticated system and problems that need a simple, well-executed solution.

  • Experience building with LLMs or other applied AI systems in production.

  • An understanding of the challenges behind reliable AI products: evaluation, context, retrieval, model behavior, latency, cost, observability, and failure modes.

  • Clear, proactive communication and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote environment.

  • Care for software craftsmanship without losing sight of momentum and customer outcomes.

Our technology

Passionfroot is built primarily in TypeScript across the full stack.

Our core product uses React, Remix, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Zero sync for real-time product experiences. Our AI systems use foundation models from multiple providers alongside the AI SDK, Typesense, and Laminar for search, agent workflows, evaluations, and observability.

You don’t need experience with everything we use. We care more about strong fundamentals, relevant product experience, and your ability to learn quickly.

What success looks like

Within your first months, you will have:

  • Developed a deep understanding of creator-led growth and the problems our customers face.

  • Taken ownership of a major product or technical area with limited oversight.

  • Improved how we build, evaluate, and operate AI-powered functionality.

  • Earned the trust of the team through reliable execution and clear communication.

  • Helped us make better product and technical decisions beyond your immediate projects.

Our interview process

We want the process to be useful, respectful, and representative of how we actually work. We don’t use take-home challenges or algorithmic whiteboard interviews.

The process typically includes:

  1. A short introductory call.

  2. A conversation with Lorenzo about your experience, ambitions, and the work you are most proud of.

  3. A technical walkthrough of a project you know deeply, focused on the decisions and trade-offs you made.

  4. A collaborative product and technical problem-solving session with members of the team.

  5. A paid work trial based on a realistic problem, which can be completed flexibly around your current commitments.

  6. References and offer.

We aim to complete the process within one to two weeks.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and equity in a Series A company.

  • Remote-first work with the option to work together in Berlin if you are local.

  • Latest Apple hardware and the tools you need to do your best work.

  • 25 days of paid vacation, plus local public holidays.

  • Regular team events and off-sites—past destinations include Mallorca, Barcelona, the South of France, Berlin, and the Baltic Sea.

jobs.title: SAP Developer
jobs.description:
About InCycling

Every year €26 billion worth of perfectly usable chemical raw materials are getting destroyed, generating millions of tonnes of avoidable CO₂ emissions and hazardous waste, not because they lack value, but because no system exists to capture it. InCycling is changing that. We are building a cloud-native AI-driven B2B platform with deep SAP integration, automated regulatory compliance workflows, and ML-based supply-vs-demand matching for scalable surplus chemical management. We are live with a couple of global DAX-tier enterprise pilot across 10+ production sites in 10+ countries and 3 continents with over 600 tonnes of surplus chemicals already in our deal pipeline. You would be joining at the moment where the foundation you build will define how the platform scales.

Tasks

The role

InCycling helps pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers trade their surplus materials instead of disposing of them. The InCycling SAP Add-on is what makes that work inside a customer's own S/4HANA system: it surfaces slow-moving and surplus batches, supports quality and compliance assessment, and moves material through its selling, shipping and billing lifecycle — all synchronized with our platform via BTP and AWS middleware. The add-on is currently built with an external implementation partner and will be handed over to us; this role takes on its technical health and growth from there. As more manufacturers come on board, each brings their own SAP landscape and processes, so the work spans steady maintenance, customer-specific extension, on-site setup, and close collaboration with both our platform backend team and the customers' SAP teams.

What you'll do

  • Take over the add-on after handover from the implementation partner and grow into full technical ownership
  • Maintain and extend the add-on's freestyle Fiori app (SAPUI5) — filter panels, multi-select tables, Flexible Column Layout, object pages and platform embedding
  • Extend the underlying ABAP RAP services (CDS entities, behavior definitions/implementations) and the OData V4 services the app consumes
  • Work across the S/4HANA backend: custom tables, batch/material status logic and the status-transition rules that govern it
  • Support the BTP integration flows that exchange batch and material data with our platform via the AWS middleware
  • Set up and deploy the add-on in customer systems, working alongside each customer's SAP team
  • Provide technical support to customers — troubleshooting, debugging, resolving integration issues
  • Implement customer-specific configurations and adaptations
  • Track work in Jira and document solutions and technical decisions in Confluence
  • Collaborate with the platform backend team on API contract changes and improvements

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 1+ years working with SAP development
  • Hands-on SAPUI5 / freestyle Fiori development (JavaScript, XML views, OData V4 consumption) — comfortable extending an existing app, not only generating one from a template
  • ABAP knowledge, with willingness to deepen RAP (CDS views, behavior definitions) and integration patterns
  • Familiarity with S/4HANA architecture
  • Customer-oriented mindset for technical support and on-site collaboration
  • Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Nice to have

  • Experience with MM, SD or QM modules
  • Exposure to SAP BTP and integration/eventing
  • Experience with add-on delivery / transport management (e.g. SAP Add-on Assembly Kit)
  • Experience with Java/Spring Boot (our platform side)

Benefits

We offer

  • The opportunity to build a digital platform from the ground up, influencing key architectural and engineering decisions;
  • A small, highly collaborative team, fast decision-making. Direct mentorship from experienced data scientists and engineers (you won’t be learning from docs alone!), direct access to founders.
  • A mission-driven product contributing to the circular economy by reducing waste and CO₂ emissions in the chemical industry.
  • A pragmatic engineering culture with modern tools, including AI-assisted development.
  • A flexible hybrid working setup and a culture built on ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Starting as a 24-month engagement tied to our funding cycle, with every intention of building a long-term journey together as InCycling grows.
  • Urban Sports Club membership as a company health benefit or a mobility budget.
  • Access to corporate employee benefits platforms with regularly changing monthly offers and discounts.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, who believe in our mission. If you do not match 100% of the requirements, but believe you can do the job, please apply: perfect candidates do not exist, but wonderful colleagues do.

jobs.title: Sr. Talent Acquisition Partner (Technical)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Technical at vCluster Labs, you aren't just filling open requisitions, you are the architect of our engineering capability across Europe. In this role, you will serve as the primary ambassador to the technical community, identifying and attracting the builders who will shape the future of vCluster. You will have the unique opportunity to partner directly with Engineering and Product leadership, as one of vCluster Labs' first TA hires on the ground in Europe.

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner, Technical, your role will include:

  • Full Cycle Technical Recruiting: Own the end to end hiring process for Engineering, Product, and Technical roles globally. You will guide candidates from the initial talent screen through the offer stage, ensuring a seamless flow.

  • Regional Technical Expertise: Serve as our first EMEA based technical recruiter and build the practices needed to hire engineering talent across the region. You will stay closely aligned with the US based People Ops and Engineering teams while adapting to local market norms.

  • Strategic Sourcing: Proactively source and engage passive talent from the open source, Kubernetes, and developer tool communities, including hard to find software engineers. You will build high quality pipelines so we do not rely solely on inbound applicants for critical technical roles.

  • Data Driven Execution: Champion our structured interview process. You will ensure scorecards are utilized effectively to reduce bias, maintaining strict data integrity within our ATS, Ashby, to inform hiring decisions.

  • Candidate Experience: Drive an exceptional experience by ensuring transparent communication. You will treat candidates with customer centric speed, ensuring decisions are made in days, not months.

  • Partnership: Collaborate with hiring managers to define technical requirements and ideal talent profiles. You will act as a true consultant on market trends and closing strategies for hard to fill engineering roles, not just an order taker.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of full cycle recruiting experience, specifically for technical roles such as Software Engineering, DevOps or Platform, and Product, within a high growth tech startup.

  • Technical Fluency: You speak the language. You understand the difference between a container and a cluster, and you are comfortable discussing technologies like Kubernetes, Go, and Terraform with candidates.

  • A Track Record on Hard Roles: You have closed genuinely hard to find engineering talent before and know how to build a pipeline when the obvious channels come up empty.

  • Location and Reach: You are based in Germany and ready to be one of vCluster Labs' first hires on the ground in Europe, working across European and US time zones as needed.

  • A Builder Mindset: You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoy refining processes to make them more efficient, especially as you stand up new technical hiring practices for the region.

  • A Data Centric Approach: You value results over tasks. You use data and analytics to track pipeline health and inform decision making.

  • High EQ and Active Listening: You are an effective communicator who genuinely listens to understand the perspectives of both candidates and hiring managers.

Bonus points for:

  • ATS Proficiency: Experience with Ashby.

  • Domain Expertise: Experience recruiting for open source technology, developer tools, or Kubernetes focused companies.

  • Global Reach: A background in hiring for distributed, remote first engineering teams.

  • HR Generalist Background: Experience beyond recruiting, such as HR operations, employee relations, or onboarding, that gives you a broader view of the employee lifecycle.

About vCluster Labs

We are a venture-backed tech startup and the company pioneering Kubernetes virtualization for the AI era. We raised +$30M from top-tier VCs such as Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, Doordash) and are in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to complement our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe and we have a remote-first work culture.

We are the leading platform for operating GPU infrastructure, enabling AI Cloud providers to deliver a hyperscaler-like experience to their customers and AI factories that need to build that same experience for their internal teams. Our platform delivers the full operational stack operators need to run their GPU data centers — managed Kubernetes, fast isolated tenant provisioning, and automated node provisioning and lifecycle management — enabling them to accelerate time to value, reduce operational burden, and maximize the ROI of every GPU.

We're the company behind vCluster, an open-source technology for virtualizing Kubernetes (10k+ GitHub stars, 40M+ virtual clusters created since 2021). Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI — a Kubernetes-native framework purpose-built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Platinum-Level Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule:  You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility:  We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.
